english.title: Permit use of a motor vehicle / trailer with equipment likely to cause danger of injury
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

the condition of its accessories or equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), was such that its use involved a danger of injury to any person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit use on a road of a motor vehicle/trailer condition of
accessories/equipment was such that involved danger of injury

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) This is an endorsable offence which requires proof that there was a danger of injury. For the less serious offences view H206, H207, H238, H239, H240 and H243.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H3100, H3101, H3102, H3103, H3104, H3106, H3107 and H3108.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.
Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.
Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

dvlacode.description: (Causing or Permitting) Causing or likely to cause danger by reason of use of unsuitable vehicle or using a vehicle with parts or accessories (excluding brakes, steering or tyres) in a dangerous condition
